verdict.rationale: Gemini supports importing whole folders/GitHub repos and uploading multiple documents at once (docs-2/14/25/43), and can schedule recurring automated actions (docs-8/48), which offer some batch/automation capability. However there is no evidence of true bulk operations across many discrete items (e.g., batch-editing many files, rows, or messages in one action) — missing for 10: explicit multi-item batch processing/editing evidence, agentic loop over item lists, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk-scale automation.
